## Functions!

Starting small with 
```{r}
x_vec = rnorm(25, mean = 5, sd = 3)

(x_vec - mean(x_vec)) / sd(x_vec)
```


Let's turn this into a function.

```{r}
z_scores = function(x) {
  
  if (!is.numeric(x)) {
    stop("Input x must be numeric")
  } else if (length(x) < 5) {
    stop("x should have 5 or more numbers")
  }
  
  z = (x - mean(x)) / sd(x)
  
  return(z)

}
```

Does this actually work?

```{r}
z_scores(x_vec)
z_scores(rpois(4000, lambda = 12))
```

Don't run these on knitting: 

```{r eval = FALSE}

z_scores(iris) # have to plug in numeric vector

z_scores("my name is Jeff")

z_scores(c(TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE)) #eeeekkkkk it works but we dont like it

z_scores(3)
```

## Mean and sd

```{r}
mean(x_vec)
sd(x_vec)
```

Write a function that returns the mean and sd of an input vector.

```{r eval = FALSE}
mean_and_sd = function(x) {
  
  return_df =
    tibble(
      mean = mean(x),
      sd = sd(x)
    )
  
  return(return_df)
  
}
```

Putting it in the source folder lets us do:

```{r}
source("source/mean_and_sd.R")
```

Check that this works!

```{r}
mean_and_sd(x_vec)
```
